name: Downward Dog
instructions: Start on your hands and knees, then tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back so your body forms an inverted V.
Press your hands into the floor and push your chest toward your thighs.
Press your heels toward the floor, keeping your back flat.
Hold the position and breathe steadily.
image_prompt_scene: With the hands and feet on the floor and the hips high in an inverted V.
